stories.story: As a first-time visitor landing on focx.ai, I want to see the Focx brand hero (eyebrow, wordmark, positioning line) with a clear path into Connect, so that I understand what Focx is and can immediately try the first sub-app.
acceptanceCriteria: apps/site/index.html renders a hero with three text elements — an eyebrow line, the 'Focx' wordmark, and a positioning line — and no longer contains the meta-refresh redirect.
The eyebrow line is styled per focx.style.brand-eyebrow (Geist Medium, brand-eyebrow size, uppercase with matching tracking).
The wordmark 'Focx' is styled per focx.style.brand-hero-desktop (focx.font.display family with a system fallback stack, brand-hero size).
The positioning line is styled per focx.style.ui-subheading (Geist Medium, subheading size).

A visible button-styled link into Connect uses the Button/Primary component pattern at Medium size, Pill shape (the same .btn/.btn--primary/.btn--md/.btn--pill classes and tokens established in apps/connect/styles.css) and its href is a root-relative path ('/skills/connect/'), not a hardcoded domain.

The page's background and text colors are drawn only from published focx color tokens, and the specific pairing chosen keeps the CTA button visibly legible (non-zero fill contrast against the page background).
node tools/drift-check/index.mjs exits 0 against apps/site/index.html and apps/site/styles.css.
apps/connect/index.html and apps/connect/styles.css are unchanged, so /skills/connect stays reachable.

outOfScope: Navigation, footer, additional marketing sections/copy, or links to any sub-app other than the single Connect CTA.

A full Button/Primary state/size/shape matrix — only Medium/Pill is used, with Default/Hover/Focused states for real interactivity (no Small/Large/Control variants, no Disabled state — there is nothing to disable on a live link).
Hosting, embedding, or fetching The Fox Tail font files — only the token's font-family value plus a system fallback stack.
Any change to apps/connect/, tools/site-compose/, render.yaml, or design/tokens/.
A full responsive breakpoint system — only a single reasonably mobile-safe layout (stacked, fluid width, no fixed pixel container).
designSystemNeeds: focx.style.brand-eyebrow, focx.style.brand-hero-desktop, focx.style.ui-subheading text styles (already published)
